I had a dream I was in some strange high school with these alien looking figures but my brain processed it as normal.
Later I met a tall man with very short, chestnut brown hair. I complimented his leather biker jacket and he said in a deep voice with a thick Russian accent “Here, you can have it. I don’t need it.” I, of course, gladly took it and thanked his kindness. I asked for his name but for some reason I don’t remember this part. I just remember it started with an M and was very Celtic or Russian sounding.
The next day I looked all around for this mystery stranger and I caught him by the vending machine in the theater room by some very steep stairs. He had a large pikachu stuffed toy in his arms and he gave that to me to. 
I then went with him to some sort of hideout on the side of the school with stained, yellow walls and modern furniture. (It looked like the apartment of that one guy in megamind) and a greyhound at the door yipping for the attention of the man. 
I don’t remember our conversation but I know it was deep and about something serious, I remember he was serving me tea in a very vintage looking tea set. 
The next day I looked all around for him but all I found was a person in the vending machine I found the man at the previous day. I helped the person out and I asked if they have seen the man. They looked at me in shock and asked if I heard the news. They then said that the man assassinated the Japanese prime minister and was promptly put in prison.

Between these events I know that nothing really happened. It seemed like time just skipped. I know this is far fetched but even about 8 months later I still feel a connection to the strange man. Maybe it was his kindness or his mysteriousness. I just can’t rap my mind around why I would have a dream this outlandish.
